asset_set: Questionnaire Q19 option 2 — Studying virus mutations

questionnaire.question_text: Which repair work would you prefer?

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single soft cel shadow ellipse under microscope and wrists — kept light, never clinical or ominous
art_style.texture: none on skin; no texture on cell-blob shapes — kept smooth and rounded
art_style.mood: calm curious science energy — symbolic and gentle, never clinical distress or outbreak panic
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
sick or distressed figures, hospital beds, or syringes
anatomically accurate pathogens or spike-protein shapes

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint cool #F0F4FF highlight on knuckle tops and dish rim
color.accent_rule: violet appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on the microscope lens rim and dish edge
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 10% opacity under microscope and hands — soft, never heavy

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: gently positions the petri dish beneath the lens
right_hand.grip: flat palm supporting the dish underside

pose.gesture_summary: mid-focus freeze frame — the dish settling into view as focus sharpens
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: both hands, cuff visible at wrist

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of gloved hands adjusts a microscope focus knob while the other gently positions a petri dish holding soft, abstract cell-blob shapes rendered as friendly rounded lavender forms — never anatomically graphic. The scene reads as calm curious science, entirely symbolic, with no medical distress, illness, or crisis imagery.

primary_objects.name: microscope
primary_objects.detail: single eyepiece edge and focus knob, no brand markings

primary_objects.name: petri dish
primary_objects.detail: shallow dish holding two soft rounded lavender cell-blob shapes, purely abstract

primary_objects.name: cell-blob shapes
primary_objects.detail: two rounded friendly blobs with soft dot details, no spikes or menacing shapes

primary_objects.name: lab glove cuff
primary_objects.detail: cuff edge only, no full glove texture

subject.environment: clean lab bench strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, no hazard signage or crowd
subject.sensitive_handling: Depict virus and cell study only as soft, abstract, rounded lavender blob shapes on a petri dish and microscope — never anatomically accurate pathogens, spike proteins, sick patients, needles, biohazard symbols, hazmat suits, or outbreak/pandemic imagery. Tone must read as calm scientific curiosity, not crisis.

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from petri dish → cell-blob shapes → microscope lens
focal_hierarchy: petri dish and cell-blob shapes center mass
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: clean lab bench strip only
composition.thumbnail_readability: microscope silhouette + petri dish readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter I, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, biohazard symbol, syringe, sick patient, hospital bed, hazmat suit, virus spike imagery, outbreak map, pandemic crisis, blood, illness distress

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector education illustration, 640x640 square, transparent PNG background. KursoKo career quiz choice image for activity "Studying virus mutations". Style: friendly flat vector with consistent 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal soft cel shadow under hands only — match KursoKo RIASEC sticker art family but NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms in a cream lab-coat sleeve with violet #4B2C7F cuff pinstripe, violet nitrile gloves. Left hand turns a dark-grey microscope focus knob. Right hand gently holds a clear petri dish containing two soft, rounded, friendly lavender cell-blob shapes with simple dot details — purely abstract, never anatomically graphic. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, generous transparent margins, clean lab bench strip fading to transparent. Mood: calm curious scientific wonder, entirely symbolic — no biohazard, illness, or outbreak imagery. Readable silhouette at small thumbnail size. Sensitive topic handled with gentle symbolism only.
